title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Ava Martinez
description: Add RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples, plus docs site updates and small SDK example fixes. Motivation: provide production-oriented quickstarts for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) plus a set of tool-calling recipes that demonstrate safe tool integration and structured output. This PR includes three new quickstarts (python, typescript, go), a new example playbook that wires a RAG agent to a search document store and a calendar tool, and companion docs site pages + sidebar entries. Checklist: - [x] Add quickstart examples under redwood-examples/rag-agents - [x] Add tool-calling recipes and test harness - [x] Docs site pages and sidebar updates - [x] Run example unit tests and docs build - [x] Address reviewer feedback and security review notes Links: docs-preview.redwood.ai/rag-agents, Linear ENG-4821, support ticket SUP-721.

Docs: add rag-agent guide, tool-calling recipes page, and sidebar navigation

Docs build: regenerate site navigation and compensate for markdown linting

release_notes: Add RAG agent quickstarts (python/ts/go), tool-calling recipes (calendar, search), and docs site guide for RAG agents. Includes security guidance for safe tool usage and small SDK example sync.
notes: This PR intentionally keeps runtime code changes minimal; focus is on examples and docs to help customers adopt RAG patterns.
QA: examples are smoke-tested locally and in CI example-integration job; recommend monitoring the docs-preview for feedback before wider rollout.
